Retrieval quality.case_pass_rate: Share of retrieval cases satisfying every applicable benchmark contract.
Retrieval quality.evidence_chunk_recall: Required source chunk IDs returned divided by required source chunk IDs.
Retrieval quality.concept_recall: Required graph concepts returned divided by required graph concepts.
Retrieval quality.relation_recall: Required graph relations returned divided by required graph relations.
Retrieval quality.forbidden_evidence_count/rate: Observed regression-backed forbidden evidence items and the share of cases containing any.
Retrieval quality.retrieval_adequacy_rate/error_rate: Share reported adequate and mean retrieval error count across benchmark cases.
Retrieval quality.dangling_edge_count/chunk_node_count: Structural graph diagnostics for dangling edges and leaked chunk nodes.
Retrieval quality.context_precision_at_10: Weighted reviewed relevance in the first ten ranked Analyst source slots divided by ten.
Retrieval quality.context_recall: Reviewed required answer points supported by returned Analyst evidence divided by all required answer points.
Retrieval quality.concept/relation diagnostics: Separate ID, label, and relation-spec recall used to explain aggregate misses.

Runtime task behavior.task_success_rate: Runs passing every applicable gating contract divided by evaluated runs.
Runtime task behavior.routing_correctness: Share of applicable runs whose worker sequence matches an allowed route.
Runtime task behavior.required/forbidden_agent_compliance: Share of applicable runs containing every required agent or avoiding every forbidden agent.
Runtime task behavior.path_efficiency_ratio: Shortest allowed completed worker path divided by actual worker steps, capped at one; incomplete runs are N/A.
Runtime task behavior.tool_selection_correctness: Share of applicable runs satisfying required and forbidden tool contracts.
Runtime task behavior.tool_argument_validity: Share of observed required tool calls satisfying every argument constraint.
Runtime task behavior.one_tool_per_worker: Share of applicable worker steps that comply with the one-tool boundary.
Runtime task behavior.retrieval_status_correctness: Share of applicable runs with an allowed local retrieval status and outcome.
Runtime task behavior.local_to_web_fallback_correctness: Share of applicable runs that escalate, or avoid escalation, according to the scenario contract.
Runtime task behavior.unnecessary_web_rate: Tavily-using runs divided by scenarios that explicitly forbid web use.
Runtime task behavior.source_exhaustion_correctness: Share of applicable runs whose source-exhaustion state matches the contract.
Runtime task behavior.final_response/modality/termination rate: Shares satisfying final-response presence, requested output modality, and workflow termination contracts.
Runtime task behavior.graph_contract_rate: Share of graph-applicable runs passing all structural and required-anchor checks.

Reliability.repetition_count: Number of runtime observations contributing to this fingerprint.
Reliability.pass_rate and Wilson interval: Functional pass proportion with sample count represented by a 95% Wilson interval.
Reliability.route_consistency: Per repeated scenario, fraction following its most common worker route.
Reliability.evidence_set_jaccard_stability: Mean pairwise Jaccard overlap of evidence IDs for repetitions of the same scenario.
Reliability.looping_rate: Runs with an identical worker/action signature repeated after Orchestrator return divided by applicable runs.
Reliability.output_limit_hit_rate: Runs observing a provider output-limit stop or classified truncation divided by runtime runs.
Reliability.failure_type_frequency: Counts of classified provider, parser, tool, storage, timeout, truncation, recursion, and workflow failures.

Efficiency.worker_steps: Distribution of non-Orchestrator worker executions per run.
Efficiency.logical_llm_calls: Distribution of logical model operations before provider-level retries.
Efficiency.provider_attempts: Distribution of actual provider attempts, including retries.
Efficiency.retries/retry_rate: Retry counts and total retries divided by total provider attempts.
Efficiency.tavily_searches: Distribution of Tavily tool calls per run.
Efficiency.input/output/total_tokens: Provider-reported token distributions; unavailable observations are omitted, not zero-filled.
Efficiency.tokens_per_successful_run: Total tokens across evaluated runs divided by functionally successful runs; N/A when none succeed.
Efficiency.latency_seconds: End-to-end time-to-resolution distribution with mean, median, and p95.
Efficiency.gating: False means efficiency limits are reported but do not initially fail functional task success.

Optional semantic quality.claim_faithfulness: Counts supported, partially supported, and unsupported factual claims against captured bounded evidence.
Optional semantic quality.grounded_claim_rate: Supported claims plus half-weighted partial claims divided by all classified factual claims.
Optional semantic quality.analyst_usefulness: Boolean judge rate for direct, clear, non-substitutive Analyst answers.
Optional semantic quality.mentor_pedagogy: Boolean judge rate for learner-aware hints and appropriate instructional next steps.
Optional semantic quality.conversational_continuity: Boolean judge rate for preserving topic and interaction mode from recent state.
Optional semantic quality.graph_usefulness: Boolean judge rate for relevant, useful labeled graph relationships.
Optional semantic quality.judge_execution_diagnostics: Per-dimension result, success, error, and actual provider-attempt counts with privacy-safe failure reasons.

details: Failures: Mentor continuation routing/worker-step contract and RetNet contextual web-topic contract. Three interrupted observations have no runtime record or score.

Configuration: Orchestrator routing v6 / graph-index v2, Retriever v7, Researcher v6, Analyst v6 and Mentor v4. Generative roles used the variable openrouter/free route; serving identities were not always observed.
Analyst used legacy vector context; Visualizer used optimized retrieval. Document, index and graph stores were local, vector storage Pinecone, and checkpoints MongoDB.
All 12 completed runtime records lack complete token totals. Runtime attempt reservations were 45 of 54; full effort used 79 of 92, including failures and retries.
